title: Generate built-in role templates from YAML + linting + versioned release artifacts
author: Jordan Lee
description: Context: As part of RBAC v2 we want built-in role templates (Org Admin, Security Admin, Read-only Auditor, Deployment Operator, etc.) to be (a) human-reviewable, (b) lintable in CI, and (c) published as versioned artifacts that services (Control Plane, Console, Private installer) can consume deterministically. This PR introduces a YAML-first source of truth under policy_bundle/roles/*.yaml and a generator that produces the canonical JSON bundle consumed by platform components. It also adds a lint/validation suite to enforce naming/versioning conventions, uniqueness constraints, and cross-scope safety checks, and formalizes an artifact versioning scheme tied to the repo release version. Summary of changes: (1) New role template YAML schema (name, description, scopes, included_permissions, excluded_permissions, constraints) with examples for common templates; (2) Generator CLI (scripts/generate_role_templates) that outputs dist/role_templates.json and dist/role_templates.min.json with stable ordering and content hashes; (3) Lint rules: permission string format + deprecation markers, role name uniqueness, duplicate permissions, forbidden permission combos for auditor roles, and scope validation (org/project/environment/cluster); (4) Release artifact scheme: dist/ artifacts include a bundle_version (semver) and policy_bundle_revision (git SHA) and we tag releases using vX.Y.Z; consumers pin either semver tag or SHA for deterministic rollouts; (5) CI updates: add "rbac-policy-lint" and "rbac-policy-generate" checks; block merge if generated output is out of date; (6) Docs: CONTRIBUTING notes for adding/modifying templates and guidance on bumping bundle versions. Follow-ups: We will add Private-specific operator roles in pr-201 and wire consumption into redwood monorepo (Control Plane + Console) behind RBAC v2 feature flags.
commits: feat(role-templates): add YAML schema + initial built-in templates
feat(generator): generate dist/role_templates.json with stable ordering
chore(ci): add lint + generation checks and fail on dirty working tree
feat(versioning): embed bundle_version + revision into artifacts
docs: update CONTRIBUTING for role template workflow
review_conversation: Marcus Lin: Can we ensure templates can’t accidentally grant break-glass or policy-admin permissions? I want a hard block for auditor roles and any role marked "auditor": true.

Jordan Lee (author): Added lint rule: roles with category=audit must not include any permission in the "privileged_admin" set (manage_roles, manage_role_bindings, rotate_keys, break_glass_*). Also added explicit allowlist for read-only permissions and a test case.
Naomi Feldman: Please confirm naming/versioning aligns with ADR-014 (namespace + versioning). Also want a clear path for deprecating templates without breaking existing customers.

Jordan Lee (author): Template IDs now follow <namespace>:<role_name>@v<major> (e.g., redwood:read_only_auditor@v1). Deprecation is via deprecated_at + replacement_template_id fields in YAML; generator emits both and consumers can surface warnings.
Diego Santos: How do scopes map for Dedicated/Private? I’m worried we’ll hard-code Hosted assumptions. Can YAML express cluster scope for Private operators?

Jordan Lee (author): Added scope_types enum including cluster and environment; YAML supports multiple scope_types per template. Generator validates constraints (e.g., cluster scope requires resource_type=cluster). Private-specific roles are coming in pr-201; this PR unblocks the schema.
Connor O'Brien: On versioning: do we want semver per bundle or per template? We need deterministic pins and a way to hotfix quickly without broad role changes.

Jordan Lee (author): Bundle is semver for release artifacts; templates carry their own major version in template_id. Minor/patch changes should be backwards compatible within a template major. Hotfixes can ship as bundle patch version while preserving template major, with changelog entries.
Elliot Price: Docs request: add a short section in CONTRIBUTING about running generator locally and how CI enforces it.
Jordan Lee (author): Added "Workflow" section with make targets: make lint, make generate, make test. CI fails if dist outputs differ.
release_notes: New YAML-first source of truth for built-in RBAC role templates.
Generator produces deterministic, versioned role template artifacts in dist/.
CI enforces linting + generated output up-to-date to prevent drift.
Artifacts embed bundle_version and git revision for evidence-friendly traceability.
